title: Junta constant testing program
statement: For dimension $n$, parameter $k\in\mathbb N$, and failure parameter $\delta\in(0,1/2]$, the program with random-example access applies the junta constant decision rule at $k$ to the output of the scheduled Fourier coefficient estimator run on the empty coordinate set with the prescribed junta constant accuracy and failure parameter $\delta$.
caveat: The estimator program, junta constant accuracy, and threshold are referenced but not defined in the supplied statement.
